dataset: Mozilla Common Voice (fa), clean subset, CC-0
normalization: v2: polish + normalize_persian applied to both reference and hypothesis
decoding: beam_size=5, VAD filter on, no initial prompt, language-drift guard (mirrors the product engine), CPU int8
